positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Doing cool stuff on the Japanese Manga Reader team
https://www.amazon.co.jp/manga

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Worked as a member of the Japanese Manga Discovery team, where I owned the design, development, and delivery of a new end actions experience inside of the manga web reader
• Created many new front-end components utilizing Typescript, React, and CSS(Sass)
• Created and updated several back-end APIs to generate book data along with book recommendations and timed promotions based on customer info, utilizing Spring and Kotlin
• Created unit tests for all code changes, utilizing MockK and Jest
• Drove design and architecture reviews with team members along with product and business stakeholders to ensure that the best possible experience was being provided to all manga customers while also being technically reliable and scalable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on Wayfair's Homepage & Landing Experiences team, where I completed several Full Stack projects using mainly PHP and React
• Created and updated several components on Wayfair's Homepage & Holiday Hub, which are now used by millions of Wayfair customers every day, using React and CSS(Sass)
• Optimized and refactored several back-end components of Wayfair's Holiday Hub to meet current best practices and increase performance, using PHP, SQL, and GraphQL

positions.title: 2020 Hack.Diversity Fellow
positions.description: • 1 of 75 candidates selected into Hack.Diversity fellowship, career leadership, and workforce development program integrating Boston's innovation, corporate, civic, academic, and philanthropic pillars.
